home.hero_title: Five areas, one union, one purpose.
home.hero_subtitle: The Shanan Gibe Student Union brings together students from Shanan Gibe studying at Jimma University — to learn from each other, support each other, and grow together.
home.meaning_body: People who come together for one purpose, work together, and support one another to grow. Standing together creates unity, and unity creates strength — the strength to solve problems, and to act before problems ever take root.
home.pillar_1_body: Bringing students of the area together and building their capacity.
home.pillar_2_body: Ending inferiority complex and building genuine pride in who we are.
home.pillar_3_body: Members teaching members, sharing accurate and useful information.
home.pillar_4_body: Researching and documenting the values and history of Shanan Gibe for the generations to come.
home.pillar_5_body: Receiving new students warmly and seeing graduating members off with pride.
home.stat_1: A shared strength no one has to build alone
home.stat_2: Members teach and support each other
home.stat_3: A strong foundation for the generation after us

about.title: About the Union
about.definition_body: GBSG is built by people who came together for a shared purpose, working and supporting one another to grow. Standing united creates unity and shared strength — strength to resolve problems, and to prevent problems before they arise.
about.mission_body: To unite students of the area and build their capacity, foster healthy competition, end inferiority complex, and grow patriotism. To help members teach and support one another, share accurate and necessary information, research and preserve the values and history of Shanan Gibe, welcome new students to the university, and send off graduating members with honor.
about.vision_body: To raise a generation strong in knowledge, discipline, and patriotism — one that plays a leading role in society and the country. In the short term, to strengthen students; in the long run, to guide the Shanan Gibe community toward growth and be a model of positive change.
about.bylaw_body: Regulation No. 2/2017 is the working foundation of the union. It describes governance, purpose, vision, mission, and the rights and duties of members in detail, and clarifies the role of leadership and the union's different bodies.
about.role_2: Offer honest ideas and feedback, and work toward the union's goals.
about.role_3: When every member carries their responsibility, the union reaches great heights.
